components.name: Primary action
components.description: Existing tenant primary action, with hover, focus, and disabled treatment.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.65rem 1.1rem;border-radius:var(--xl-radius-sm,.625rem);font:600 1rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s,border-color .16s;border:1px solid var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);background:var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);color:var(--xl-content-on-color,#FFFFFF)}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--xl-action-primary-hover,#3A4FBF)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: White outlined secondary control; this specimen does not perform a route action.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.65rem 1.1rem;border-radius:var(--xl-radius-sm,.625rem);font:600 1rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s,border-color .16s;border:1px solid var(--xl-border-default,#E2E8F0);background:var(--xl-surface-canvas,#FFFFFF);color:var(--xl-content-primary,#2D3748)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--xl-surface-subtle,#F8FAFC);border-color:var(--xl-border-strong,#CBD5E0)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Directory search
components.description: The actual visible label, placeholder, search-icon position, and tenant field geometry.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;max-width:26rem;color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C);font:400 .875rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-search>span{font-weight:500}.ds-search-field{position:relative}.ds-search-icon{position:absolute;left:.9rem;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}.ds-search-input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:2.875rem;padding:.65rem .85rem .65rem 2.6rem;border:1px solid var(--xl-border-default,#E2E8F0);border-radius:var(--xl-radius-sm,.625rem);background:var(--xl-surface-canvas,#FFFFFF);color:var(--xl-content-primary,#2D3748);font:inherit;caret-color:var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB)}.ds-search-input::placeholder{color:var(--xl-content-placeholder,#667085)}.ds-search-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Governance section navigation
components.description: Four underline-selected sections; the same navigation reflows to a two-by-two phone grid.
components.html: <nav class="ds-governance" aria-label="Tenant governance sections"><button class="ds-governance-tab" type="button" aria-current="page">People</button><button class="ds-governance-tab" type="button">Course ownership</button><button class="ds-governance-tab" type="button">Alert rules</button><button class="ds-governance-tab" type="button">Audit</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-governance{display:flex;gap:2rem;overflow-x:auto;font-family:var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-governance-tab{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;border-radius:0;padding:1rem 0;color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C);font:600 1rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-governance-tab[aria-current=page]{color:var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);border-color:var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB)}.ds-governance-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-governance{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 1.25rem;overflow:visible}.ds-governance-tab{justify-content:center;min-height:2.75rem;padding:.5rem 0}}

components.name: Record status badge
components.description: Compact text-labeled lifecycle states; SAVED uses the existing success surface, DRAFT the warning surface.
components.css: .ds-badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem}.ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;border-radius:.4rem;padding:.2rem .65rem;background:var(--xl-surface-muted,#EDF2F7);color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C);font:600 .875rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);white-space:nowrap}.ds-badge-saved{color:var(--xl-feedback-success,#276749);background:rgba(72,187,120,.1)}.ds-badge-draft{color:var(--xl-feedback-warning,#9C4221);background:rgba(237,137,54,.1)}

components.name: Dashboard metric
components.description: The actual unavailable-count state; no sample statistic is supplied.
components.html: Total users—Count unavailable
components.css: .ds-metric{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;padding:1.5rem;border:1px solid var(--xl-border-default,#E2E8F0);border-radius:var(--xl-radius-md,.9375rem);background:var(--xl-surface-canvas,#FFFFFF);color:var(--xl-content-primary,#2D3748);font:400 1rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-metric-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;margin-bottom:1.25rem}.ds-metric-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:2.75rem;height:2.75rem;border-radius:var(--xl-radius-sm,.625rem);background:rgba(230,227,255,.65);color:var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB)}.ds-metric-label{font-size:.875rem;color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C)}.ds-metric-value{display:block;font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;margin-top:.5rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-metric-unavailable{font-size:.875rem}@media(max-width:480px){.ds-metric{padding:1rem}}

components.name: Policy summary
components.description: Native disclosure with the real unavailable-system-default message and per-group unsaved marker.
components.html:
Learning inactivitySystem default values unavailable until the policy is saved.Unsaved changes

Override values are not used in the current mode.
components.css: .ds-policy{border:1px solid var(--xl-border-default,#E2E8F0);border-radius:var(--xl-radius-md,.9375rem);background:var(--xl-surface-canvas,#FFFFFF);color:var(--xl-content-primary,#2D3748);font:400 1rem var(--xl-font-family, 'HarmonyOS Sans TC', Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif)}.ds-policy-summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1.5rem;padding:1.5rem;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-policy-summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-policy-copy strong,.ds-policy-copy small{display:block}.ds-policy-copy strong{font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:600}.ds-policy-copy small{margin-top:.5rem;color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C);line-height:1.6}.ds-policy-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.25rem;font-size:.875rem;color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C);white-space:nowrap}.ds-policy-unsaved{color:var(--xl-feedback-warning,#9C4221)}.ds-policy-detail{margin:0;padding:0 1.5rem 1.25rem;font-size:.875rem;color:var(--xl-content-secondary,#5D6B7C)}.ds-policy-summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--xl-action-primary,#4835EB);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-policy-summary{padding:1.25rem;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem}.ds-policy-meta{justify-content:space-between;width:100%}}

narrative.overview:
Tenant Administration extends the existing X-Learn operational workspace: calm, precise enterprise operations with compact information density, clear record hierarchy, and a visible next action. Cool-gray working space, white outlined surfaces, inherited HarmonyOS Sans TC typography, and violet wayfinding express the supplied Tenant Admin frames without creating a separate brand.

This is an Operate surface. Scanability, honest state, and record continuity outrank spectacle. Dashboard summaries lead into governance, intakes, and assessment records; contextual drawers and explicit draft states preserve the surrounding task.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-gray canvas and white outlined working surfaces.
One violet action voice with semantic, text-labeled state.
Wide desktop records with deliberate phone reflow.
Context-preserving drawers and honest server-versus-local state.

rules.name: The One Violet Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet means selected, actionable, or focused. Do not use it as ambient decoration across whole screens.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Meaningful Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation through hierarchy or temporary overlay behavior. Prefer a border or tonal change for ordinary grouping.

dos: Do reuse the current semantic tokens and preserve the supplied Tenant Admin composition.
Do keep loading, unavailable, error, empty, unsaved, and saved states visibly distinct.
Do preserve mobile record labels, visible focus, and explicit secondary-filter disclosure.
Do keep screenshot fidelity, frontend contract behavior, and authenticated live acceptance separate.
donts: Don't infer learning activity from active accounts or count published versions as published templates.
Don't fabricate people photographs, statistics, recent-login dates, or portal versions.
Don't invent arbitrary alert rules, Speaking authoring, or saved-section editing.
Don't promote this route-scoped composition into new global design rules.
